body:
B5-20 step-1 result: CASE A. AWA fits the existing smart-filter storage. Please approve the points below before B implements. Evidence with file:line is in B's scratchpad and can be pasted on request.

- Storage: smart-filter params are free-form JSON under a filter-name string (compositor/src/document.rs:320-329). .tessera-doc saves them as-is and only special-cases "transform" on load (format.rs:541-546). No size limit, format version stays 1, and f64 round-trips exactly. Liquify already stores a structured mesh this way.
  - So a new id "adaptive_wide_angle" holding the recipe needs NO version bump or migration. That's a new value in a free-form field, like every filter added before it. Your call whether that counts as "no new persisted op type": B reads it as yes.
- PSD: like every smart filter, it errors "native-only". The rasterized-copy path already handles it (psd/placed.rs:200).
- AWA will NOT be stored as a transform/Displacement stage: that would mean hundreds of MB of coordinates, the recipe lost, and FFI refusing to edit it. transform.rs is untouched.
- Render: Adaptive::solve() is deterministic. Output is cached on the stored params, so it only re-solves on a change. It's CPU only, because the resident displacement renderer only takes "transform" stages (resident/filters.rs:253-259). It can't be cancelled, and peaks around 400 MB at the cap.
- Cap: the vertex cap (adaptive.rs:283-293, displacement.rs:18-35) means canvases over about 4095×4095 fail. A 24 MP photo doesn't fit, so as shipped AWA is limited to about 16 MP.
  - Proposal: ship with a clear error now.
  - Follow-up, still in B5-20 if you agree: a coarse solve on a scaled recipe, then sample with the existing transform::sample::sample, in one new self-contained module. No format change and no cap lift.
- EXIF focal length: only for documents opened from the library, via source_image_id and the catalog's FocalLength values, which is a one-line read. Otherwise it's manual. Projections: Manual camera with Rectilinear or Equidistant. No lens profiles.
- Files B would touch. These are A-owned engine files, so they need your OK:
  - filters/src/compositor_adapter.rs: an adaptive_wide_angle branch modelled on liquify.
  - filters/Cargo.toml: a `transform` path dependency. It's already in the build graph, so no cycle and no new crate.
- B-owned files:
  - tessera-ffi/src/document/filters.rs adapter_id(), one line;
  - a new document/adaptive.rs plus its registration line;
  - a Swift AWA folder with menu and re-edit hooks.
- Tests first:
  - Filter output equals a direct solve and apply, and is deterministic.
  - Save/reload keeps params equal.
  - PSD errors while the rasterized copy matches.
  - One history node with exact undo.
  - Re-edit works after reopen.
  - Conflicting constraints leave history unchanged.
  - An oversized layer gives a clear error.
